title: HSK Practice 2: 选词填空, 判断对错, 阅读理解
description: More HSK-style practice with the second half of A2: choose the word from a small word bank, true/false, and short reading.

points.title: 选词填空: choose the word
points.summary: In the HSK, several sentences share one word bank. Here each question shows four words from the same bank: 已经, 怎么, 差不多, 离, 跟, 一直.
points.body:
- 已经…了 = already.
- 怎么 + 还 / 不 = how come.
- 差不多 = about the same.
- A 离 B 远 / 近 = distance.
- 跟 = with.
- 一直 = all along.
examples: {我|wǒ}{已经|yǐjīng}{等|děng}{了|le}{你|nǐ}{一个|yí ge}{小时|xiǎoshí}{了|le}！
I've been waiting for you for an hour already!

points.title: 判断对错 (2)
points.summary: Decide whether the ★ statement matches the passage.
points.body: Watch for: 什么都没 (nothing at all), 走路 vs 坐车, comparisons with 比 / 没有, and 以前 vs 现在.

points.title: 阅读理解 (2)
points.summary: Answer the ★ question. Times often need a small calculation; locations need the right position word.
points.body:
- Subtract the travel time to get the departure time.
- 旁边 / 上面 / 下面 / 对面 — read carefully.

notes: 离 needs a place and 近/远.
怎么等了 = 'how come (I) waited' — not the meaning.
跟 needs a person after it.
questions.translation: I've been waiting for you for an hour already!

notes: 差不多还没 isn't grammatical.
跟 needs a person after it.
已经还没 is contradictory.
questions.translation: How come you're still not asleep? It's already midnight.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}{和|hé}{姐姐|jiějie}{长|zhǎng}{得|de}（　），{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{以为|yǐwéi}{我们|wǒmen}{是|shì}{双胞胎|shuāngbāotāi}。
notes: 长得怎么 isn't a statement.
离 needs a place.
长得已经 isn't grammatical.
questions.translation: My sister and I look so alike that lots of people think we're twins.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}（　）{火车站|huǒchēzhàn}{不|bù}{远|yuǎn}，{走路|zǒulù}{十|shí}{分钟|fēnzhōng}。
notes: 跟火车站 isn't distance.
怎么 doesn't fit.
一直 = 'straight / all along'.
questions.translation: My home isn't far from the train station — ten minutes on foot.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{昨天|zuótiān}{去|qù}{商店|shāngdiàn}{买|mǎi}{衣服|yīfu}，{可是|kěshì}{衣服|yīfu}{都|dōu}{太|tài}{贵|guì}{了|le}，{所以|suǒyǐ}{我|wǒ}{什么|shénme}{都|dōu}{没|méi}{买|mǎi}。

★ {他|tā}{昨天|zuótiān}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{衣服|yīfu}。
notes: 什么都没买 = he bought nothing.
questions.translation: Yesterday I went to the shop to buy clothes, but everything was too expensive, so I didn't buy anything. ★ He bought clothes yesterday.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{离|lí}{学校|xuéxiào}{很|hěn}{近|jìn}，{所以|suǒyǐ}{我|wǒ}{每天|měitiān}{走路|zǒulù}{去|qù}{上学|shàngxué}，{差不多|chàbuduō}{十|shí}{分钟|fēnzhōng}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}。

★ {他|tā}{每天|měitiān}{坐|zuò}{车|chē}{去|qù}{学校|xuéxiào}。
notes: 走路去上学 = he walks.
questions.translation: My home is close to the school, so I walk there every day — it takes about ten minutes. ★ He goes to school by car every day.

questions.prompt:
{弟弟|dìdi}{今年|jīnnián}{八|bā}{岁|suì}，{会|huì}{说|shuō}{中文|Zhōngwén}{和|hé}{英语|Yīngyǔ}，{英语|Yīngyǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{比|bǐ}{中文|Zhōngwén}{好|hǎo}。

★ {弟弟|dìdi}{的|de}{中文|Zhōngwén}{没有|méiyǒu}{英语|Yīngyǔ}{好|hǎo}。
questions.explanation: 比 ↔ **没有** say the same thing from both sides.
notes: English is better than Chinese = Chinese isn't as good as English.
questions.translation: My little brother is eight. He speaks Chinese and English, and his English is better than his Chinese. ★ His Chinese isn't as good as his English.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{以前|yǐqián}{不|bù}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{吃|chī}{辣|là}{的|de}，{来|lái}{四川|Sìchuān}{以后|yǐhòu}，{现在|xiànzài}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{了|le}。

★ {他|tā}{以前|yǐqián}{就|jiù}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{吃|chī}{辣|là}{的|de}。
notes: 以前不喜欢 = he didn't like it before.
questions.translation: I didn't use to like spicy food, but since coming to Sichuan I really like it now. ★ He already liked spicy food before.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{每天|měitiān}{早上|zǎoshang}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{起床|qǐchuáng}，{吃|chī}{完|wán}{早饭|zǎofàn}{坐|zuò}{公共汽车|gōnggòng qìchē}{去|qù}{公司|gōngsī}，{路|lù}{上|shang}{要|yào}{四十|sìshí}{分钟|fēnzhōng}。{我|wǒ}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{二十|èrshí}{到|dào}{公司|gōngsī}。

★ {他|tā}{几|jǐ}{点|diǎn}{从|cóng}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{出发|chūfā}？
notes: 8:20 − 40 minutes isn't 8:00.
That would be an hour's journey.
七点 is when he gets up.
questions.translation: I get up at seven every morning, have breakfast, then take the bus to the office — the journey takes forty minutes. I arrive at 8:20. ★ When does he leave home?

questions.prompt:
{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{的|de}{房间|fángjiān}{不|bú}{大|dà}，{可是|kěshì}{很|hěn}{干净|gānjìng}。{床|chuáng}{在|zài}{窗户|chuānghu}{旁边|pángbiān}，{桌子|zhuōzi}{在|zài}{门|mén}{旁边|pángbiān}，{桌子|zhuōzi}{上|shang}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{书|shū}。

★ {床|chuáng}{在|zài}{哪儿|nǎr}？
notes: The books are on the table.
Chairs aren't mentioned.
The table is by the door.
questions.translation: Xiao Wang's room isn't big, but it's very clean. The bed is by the window, the desk is by the door, and there are lots of books on the desk. ★ Where is the bed?

questions.prompt:
{昨天|zuótiān}{的|de}{考试|kǎoshì}{很|hěn}{难|nán}，{大家|dàjiā}{都|dōu}{觉得|juéde}{时间|shíjiān}{不|bú}{够|gòu}。{我|wǒ}{差不多|chàbuduō}{写|xiě}{完|wán}{了|le}，{可是|kěshì}{最后|zuìhòu}{一个|yí ge}{题|tí}{没|méi}{写|xiě}。

★ {关于|guānyú}{考试|kǎoshì}，{可以|kěyǐ}{知道|zhīdào}：
notes: It was 很难.
He took it.
差不多写完 — the last question is missing.
questions.translation: Yesterday's exam was hard; everyone felt there wasn't enough time. I almost finished, but didn't do the last question. ★ What do we know about the exam?
